ns2:course.label: Language Dev and Socialization
ns2:course.description: Addresses basic processes in language development, with special attention to the impact of social and cultural contexts on that process. Includes historical and contemporary theoretical frameworks of language acquisition; crosscultural investigations of communication; acquisition under atypical circumstances. Special focus on how communicative practices generate sociocultural knowledge and competence among children and how children are socialized to use language. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
